about: A migration run crashed at migrating, batch 1 round 0, before the migrator wrote anything: the real `start` claims the run, then `recover` runs at 15:45. It has no unit to undo and writes no note. The run is at recovered, waiting for flags-1. The real Edit guard, with no record files, gives []. `act` at recovered changes nothing and goes to acted; `close` writes Runs/run-2026-10-10-1545-recover.md (first line 'Recover run, for run-2026-10-10-1530-migration.', then the every-unit-undone sentence, no sections) and adds the crashed run's history entry with how 'recovered'. The handled list, which holds two entries from an earlier run, is unchanged; the unit index stays empty; every note is as it started. Replaces the old case 57, which expected the refusal 'Recover for migration runs isn't built yet.'
readings: The crashed run was waiting for no flags file (next_check null at migrating), so the recover log has no 'Markup wasn't checked on the first try.' and no Other notes (CONTRACT.md 5.6 item 8).
The history entry's ended is the time close runs; recover and close share the same now here.
No undo ran, so the case doesn't check undo-misses.json.

'Nothing needs you.' comes after the every-unit-undone sentence (CONTRACT.md 5.6 item 8), so it is the third line; nothing_needs_you is false because the runner reads only the second line, and `contains` checks the words.
